scope: General ASS event preparation, immutable layout dependencies and filtered per-frame paint replay; no playback
scheduling: One render thread, logical CPU 7, affinity 0x80, Above Normal process priority

burst_cohort.criterion: At least 1000 ASS events start since preceding source frame; selected from source timestamps before timing comparison

preparation_cost: All first-use compilation, copying and cache admission execute inside timed render/parse calls; no lookahead or startup prewarming
limitations: PC activity/frequency/cache interference remains despite one CPU and Above Normal priority
Console results do not establish dropped playback frames

synthetic_parse_x64.timings: Nested phases overlap; thread CPU clock has coarse per-frame resolution

synthetic_pixels_x64.timing_note: Offline wall times include other activity; playback captures measure end-to-end CPU independently.
